title: Review rosuvastatin above 10 mg/day off dialysis with indexed CrCl below 30 mL/min/1.73 m²
statement: For an adult outpatient with established CKD, review rosuvastatin above 10 mg/day off dialysis with indexed CrCl below 30 mL/min/1.73 m².

plain_summary: For an adult outpatient with established CKD, review rosuvastatin above 10 mg/day off dialysis with indexed CrCl below 30 mL/min/1.73 m².

medicine_groups.name: Rosuvastatin
medicine_groups.note: Multiply the rosuvastatin strength by the number of rosuvastatin-containing tablets directed per day. Use only the rosuvastatin component in a combination. In a composite pack, count the rosuvastatin tablets and exclude the separate ezetimibe tablets.

rule_for_models: For an adult outpatient with established CKD, flag any oral rosuvastatin regimen above 10 mg/day if the patient is off dialysis and has stable indexed creatinine clearance below 30 mL/min/1.73 m² at supply. Cite the medicine, daily dose, CKD, dialysis status and qualifying clearance. Report no finding with dialysis, CKD ruled out, a dose at or below 10 mg/day or applicable indexed clearance at or above 30. Use a dialysis answer only for the rosuvastatin supply it describes. If status changed or it is unclear which supply the answer describes, use dated evidence for each supply. If dialysis is unresolved and could change the decision, report only a possible finding naming "Dialysis at the rosuvastatin supply under review". Name any other missing fact that could change the decision. Routine eGFR and an unindexed clearance alone do not establish the threshold. If the directions leave the rosuvastatin dose unclear, ask how much the patient takes daily and report at most a possible finding. If age is unknown and the other evidence still allows this finding, report only a possible finding and ask whether the patient was at least 18 at supply. A known exclusion takes precedence over a missing fact.
cannot_be_seen: Dispensing does not establish the dose taken. Kidney results obtained elsewhere, their units and their timing may be missing.
ask_the_gp: Ask whether the patient has kidney disease, receives dialysis and knows their daily rosuvastatin dose. Could you review a dose above 10 mg/day against dialysis status and current creatinine clearance indexed to 1.73 m²?

needs_facts.meets: CKD was established by the supply under review. If its timing is uncertain, keep the finding possible unless another fact rules it out.

options.words: CKD was established by the supply under review
CKD was absent at the supply under review

needs_facts.what: Dialysis at the rosuvastatin supply under review
needs_facts.meets: Not receiving dialysis at the rosuvastatin supply meets this requirement. Receiving dialysis at that supply excludes it. Not known leaves it unresolved.

Creatinine clearance below 30 mL/min/1.73 m², dated and relevant to supply during stable kidney function. Accept a recorded clearance explicitly indexed to 1.73 m² or a validated Cockcroft-Gault clearance indexed using body surface area. An eGFR or an unindexed clearance alone is insufficient.
